_comment: Roadmap 2 S7: boats you drive (src/features/boats) and the river launch you ride (src/features/ferry). Models: assets/boats/boats.glb (Kenney Watercraft Kit, CC0; tools/boat-kit/boats.json) streamed after start — code-built boats are shown until it arrives. Prices: data/economy.json → prices.boats (the Products tab can override, kind 'boats'). Speeds in metres per second, turns in radians per second, times in seconds.

types._comment: model = child mesh in boats.glb; rotY = degrees to turn the model so the bow points forward; length / width = hull (metres, used for collisions and the shape of the code-built boat); seat = [left, up, forward] of the driver (metres from the middle); maxSpeed / reverseSpeed / acceleration / brake; turnRate = full turn speed at turnFullSpeed or faster; drag = water slows it (share per second); grip = how quickly a sideways slide stops; bob / pitch / roll = how much it rocks; camera = chase camera distance × the driving camera; colors = hull, deck, trim of the code-built boat; free = can be taken at any ghat for nothing; horn = horn sound.

blocked._comment: Rectangles [x0, z0, x1, z1] in world metres where boats cannot go although it is water: the Sadarghat pontoon with its three moored launches (data/landmarks.json → sadarghat).

physics._comment: margin = metres of water a boat keeps from the bank; bounce = share of speed kept (backwards) after hitting the bank; crashSpeed = hitting land faster than this sends boat:crash (a bump); pushRadius = boats push each other apart within this share of (shorter length + wider width).

wake._comment: White foam behind a moving boat: count = foam patches per boat, every = seconds between them (at full speed), life = seconds a patch lasts, size = metres.

enter._comment: range = metres from Shoumik to a moored boat to get in; exitSearch = metres around the boat searched for dry land to step out to.

docks._comment: Ghats where boats are moored. near = [col, row] in junction units (data/terrain.json units); the game finds the nearest dry spot next to open water there. free = free boats waiting there. Boats you own wait at whichever ghat you walk to (owned = how many of them fit). showDistance = boats appear when Shoumik is this close.

ferry._comment: The river launch (src/features/ferry): one launch shuttles along the Buriganga between the ghats and you ride it with passengers (like the MRT: walk to the ghat on the bank → E → wait on the pontoon → E to get on). path / ghats in junction units [col, row]. launch = like the trains: carLength/carWidth/carHeight in metres (the model is scaled to them), speed, acceleration, stopSeconds; heightScale = height of the model relative to its width. Fare: data/economy.json → fares.launch.
